title: Classes and objects

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Classes group related state and behavior into objects, such as a game character, an order, or a device model.
CORE EXPLANATION
A class describes the structure of objects. __init__ sets initial state, and self refers to the current instance.

spans.text: Classes group related state and behavior into objects, such as a game character, an order, or a device model.

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: Deep inheritance increases change risk; use inheritance only for a genuine substitutable 'is-a' relationship.
COMMON MISTAKES
Keep only related state and behavior in a class; consider a dataclass for simple value objects.
